_about: The chosen voice for each speaker: the reference clip (voice-source/<path>.wav) VoxCPM2 clones for every line. Picked by Bryan in the voice pilot rounds 1-21 (2026-11-11 to 2026-11-13), on expressive lines where tested. Sal (2026-11-13): VoxCPM2's retake of a New York performance (round 17 retake-s3); the source recording itself is never shipped, and Bryan approved this voice for this game only. Round 21 (2026-11-14, after the batch trial): Mitch, Brock and Kai re-recorded (VoxCPM retakes of their voices); Reginald and Hiro kept.
